Privacy policy

What this site stores, why, and how to ask for it to be removed. Plain language, no tracking by default.

This is a sandbox demonstration, not a commercial service. This page describes how the software behaves; it is not legal advice, and an operator who deploys it should review it against the laws that apply to them.

What we collect

  • Demo activity. Mandates, orders, approvals, disputes and audit entries you create while using the demo. They are sandbox records with no real payment data. Do not type real personal or card details into any field.
  • Contact messages. If you use the contact form we store your name, email address, optional subject and your message so we can reply. Your network address is not stored; only a salted one-way hash used to limit spam.
  • Server logs. The hosting setup may keep standard request logs (time, path, status) for security and debugging.

Cookies and similar storage

The site sets no cookies. Your browser's session storage remembers the id of the mandate you are working with in that tab, and local storage remembers your analytics choice. Both stay on your device.

Analytics

Analytics are off unless the operator configures Google Analytics. When they do, nothing loads until you press Accept on the banner, and you can change your mind with "Analytics choices" in the footer. If you decline, no analytics script is requested.

Who sees it

Contact messages are visible to the operator of this deployment, and may be forwarded to them by email if the operator enabled that. We do not sell or share them. Third parties are involved only when you choose them: PayPal if you connect a sandbox account, a language-model provider if the operator set an API key, and Google if you accept analytics.

Your choices

To see, correct or delete a contact message, contact us from the address you used. Demo records can be removed by deleting the deployment's database.

Changes

Material changes will be reflected on this page.
